adjudication.rationale: In `spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb`, the example "creates a topic view when a topic_id is found" sets `TopicView.expects(:new).with(123, nil, {best: 5})` but does not chain `.returns(...)`, so Mocha will make `TopicView.new` return `nil` by default. That means the controller assigns `@topic_view = nil` in the topic-found path. However, in typical RSpec controller specs views are not rendered (unless `render_views` is enabled), so this does not necessarily cause a failing `NoMethodError` on `@topic_view.posts` as the finding claims. The real, verifiable issue is that the “happy path” test is not validating that `@topic_view` is a usable `TopicView` instance (or that the template can render), because the mocked return value is wrong/missing.
